aside.needsRunningBrowser: not tested: testing it would mean quitting the real browser of the user. The browser was running and an account was signed in when every check below was made.
aside.whenAccountUnknown: Account not found: u999 Run 'aside account list' to see available accounts.

introspect.call: Object.getOwnPropertyNames(globalThis); typeof page[name] over a list of candidate names
introspect.evidence: 116 globals; openTab returns [object AsidePage] with 27 of the candidate methods

session.call: aside repl < fifo, one statement per line
session.evidence: a global set by one statement was read by the next; lib/prelude.js loaded

openTab.evidence: the page server received GET / after the call

waitForSelector.evidence: an element added 700 ms after load was found after 4 ms

readDom.call: page.evaluate(fn, arg) returning text and attributes
readDom.evidence: text "known text 0.95" and data-wei 950000000000000000 came back to the shell

evalInPage.evidence: an argument went in and an object with document.title came back

localStorage.call: page.evaluate reading and removing localStorage keys that start with maze:
localStorage.evidence: a key was written, listed, removed and gone

click.evidence: the page server received one trusted click

clickRefusedWhenDisabled.call: M.click waits for an enabled element
clickRefusedWhenDisabled.evidence: a disabled button was reported as disabled and received no click

fill.evidence: a native input listener saw "0.05" (events: input)

pressKey.evidence: a window keydown listener saw code ArrowRight

reload.call: page.reload(), then wait for an element
reload.evidence: the page server received one more GET / and the page came back as a new load

navigate.evidence: the tab went from / to /second and the second page was read

multiTab.call: openTab twice; each returned object addresses its own tab
multiTab.evidence: two tabs with different page ids were read one after the other

parallelClicks.call: Promise.all of locator.click() in two tabs
parallelClicks.evidence: each tab's page reported one click, the background tab included

screenshot.call: page.screenshot({ path }) inside the session directory
screenshot.evidence: a PNG of 42358 bytes was written and copied to .data/e2e-aside/probe/probe-shot.png

closeTab.evidence: the closed tab's page stopped reporting to the page server; the other tab kept reporting

tabsClosedWhenSessionEnds.evidence: the tab stopped reporting once the session had quit

tabSurvivesInvocation.evidence: the tab stopped reporting when the command returned: a scenario must stay inside one session

tabsClosedWhenStdinCloses.evidence: the tab kept reporting after the input of its session had ended

tabsClosedWhenSessionKilled.call: SIGTERM to the aside repl process
tabsClosedWhenSessionKilled.evidence: the tab kept reporting after the process of its session was stopped

leftoverTabClosable.call: attachBrowserTab(targetId), then window.close() in the page
leftoverTabClosable.evidence: every tab a dead session had left open was closed this way (states: closed closed); it works only for a tab that never navigated

execClick.evidence: not run: model-driven, non-deterministic and billed to the user's model account; the REPL covers every step. MAZE_E2E_PROBE_EXEC=1 runs it

paths.inputRule: repl when session, openTab, click, fill and evalInPage are verified; otherwise the scenario is BLOCKED (aside exec is not automated)
paths.readRule: A = repl reads the DOM when readDom is verified; otherwise B = TestBeacon and GET /api/test/ui-snapshot

notes: A scenario is one aside repl session fed over stdin: a tab does not outlive the invocation that opened it.
aside repl exits 0 even when the code threw; only the status line [ok | Nms] or [error | Nms] tells.
page.goto with its default wait can time out on a page without interactive elements; { waitUntil: "load" } does not.
locator.waitFor waits for visibility by default, so an empty element never satisfies it; the suite polls page.evaluate instead.
page.screenshot may only write inside the session directory the REPL reports as pwd.

Only a session that quits with exit closes its tabs. A tab left by a dead session can be closed from outside only with window.close() in the page, which works only while the tab has never navigated; closeTab and page.close on an attached tab only detach it, and chrome.tabs.remove is refused in the REPL.
The REPL also exposes globals connected to the accounts of the user (mail, chat, documents, passwords). The suite calls none of them.
